overview.commentary: The portfolio returned 59.63% annualised against 25.88% volatility (Sharpe 1.76) — excellent risk-adjusted performance at a elevated risk level. HPE carries the largest weight at 2.9%; SNDK dominates risk contribution at 8.2%. On a typical bad day expect losses near 3.08% (95% VaR), with the worst 5% averaging 3.72% (CVaR) and peak-to-trough drawdown over the period of -11.40%. Action: profile looks balanced; monitor correlation drift around the next earnings cycle.

risk.commentary: Monte Carlo (10k paths, 1Y horizon): 95% VaR 6.34%, 99% VaR 19.21%, CVaR 95% 14.35%. Probability of >20% loss: 0.85%. Worst historical replay is GFC_peak_to_trough (-57.57% return, max drawdown -58.46%, worst day -13.36%). GARCH(1,1) 30-day forecast vol is 24.39% vs realised 21.68% — vol regime rising. Persistence alarm: C, ARE, INTC, EG, MU, SNDK, TWLO, LITE, WDC, STX, GPN, LEN, FISV, COF have α+β > 0.95, meaning shocks decay slowly — drawdowns there will compound longer than a Gaussian model would imply.
